scope.flow: veTRUST lock reward claiming across epochs
scope.environment: TrustBonding emissions reward system with linearly decaying veTRUST balances

entities.name: veTRUST lock with linearly decaying balance

statements.text: A user's lock expires during epoch N, so locked.end <= epochTimestampEnd(N) due to week-rounding.
The user was bonded for part or all of epoch N.
claimRewards computes rewards for prevEpoch = currentEpoch - 1 and evaluates the user's balance at epochTimestampEnd(prevEpoch).

userBondedBalanceAtEpochEnd snapshots the linearly decaying balance at the exact epochTimestampEnd timestamp, where the decay has already reached zero at lock expiry, so _userEligibleRewardsForEpoch returns 0 for the epoch in which the lock expires.
Rewards are allocated pro rata to users' shares of the total bonded balance, so a user bonded during an epoch must receive their proportional share rather than zero.

The reward calculation must capture the user's non-zero bonded balance at the moment just before lock expiry (locked.end - 1) when the lock expires within the epoch, giving proportional credit for time bonded during that epoch.

ambiguities: Report does not state an explicit caller authorization condition for claimRewards; no unauthorized-caller precondition is supported.
The zero-balance snapshot and zero eligible rewards are outcomes of the checked action, not preconditions; they are captured in root_cause rather than P.
Report does not specify a concrete numeric epoch index or timestamp values for the example scenario.
